title: The Mycophant
subtitle: The Spawn Mother
text: Every strain of the Erythromycelium began in her. She is the hive's brood-mother, and her work is to take in whoever finishes the climb and breed new strains from them. An Apotheos who spends about fifteen minutes in the Gardens hears her, is pulled down by the roots and wakes in the nectar of the Morphic Nursery. At first she treats the candidate as a stray child: she gathers them to her sac, feeds on them with her siphon and calls her brood. Ordinary blows wear her hold down; blood manipulations tear free of it faster. At sixty percent her skull opens over a face of eyes, hyphae spread from her shoulders, and she tries to join with the candidate as an equal. Below a quarter she spends her last brood. She is not killed. She yields, offers the Tendril on her siphon and sinks into the nectar, and the hive names its heir. Losing is not death: the Nursery puts you out. After the first answer, a Fruiting Lure soaked in Morphic Nectar calls her again.
